name: Tormentbringer

bonuses.name: Allure of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: Attack Tests made against the Tormentbringer use Willpower as their Attribute - ranged attacks use Ballistic Skill (Wil), melee attacks use Weapon Skill (Wil).

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Herald of Slaanesh
bonuses.text: If any Daemonette is within Short Range of this Threat, they may re-roll any 1s on their attack rolls.

abilities.name: Disquieting Creature & Quicksilver Swiftness
abilities.text: Anyone that can see or hear the Tormentbringer must pass a DN 3 Fear Test. The Tormentbringer then acts first in the Initiative order as though they had Seized the Initiative.

abilities.name: Soulstain
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. The Tormentbringer attempts to activate a psychic power from the Soulstain Discipline or Deny the Witch (Wrath & Glory, p. 267).

abilities.name: Exquisite Agonies
abilities.text: When this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical, its attacks gain the Agonising Trait. If they already have this Trait, the attack inflicts 1 additional Shock.

note: The Seeker Chariot, Exalted Seeker Chariot (pp.96-97) and Hellflayer (p.97) are vehicle-format blocks, not transcribed.
determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
